commit.message:
Add a stub for instantiating the PCIe AXI-S SS instead of DM (#1341)

There's enough perturbation from the Verilog hierarchy alone to make this
a commit of its own. No new features except conditional instantiation of
the AXI-S stub.

Pin updates needed for 24.3 -- compatible with 24.1 (#1511)

- Clean up some DDR pins that aren't arrays.
- Mark unused (commented out) pins VIRTUAL_PIN. Quartus was binding them to
  random locations.
- inout pins can't be virtual (i2c scl/sda). Bind them to physical pins
  on I-series dev kit.
- Note clk_100m and DDR clocks are asynchronous. This ought to be obvious, but
  they share a few nearby I/O buffers, causing timing errors.
